description: This file defines the Customer controller class in the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing customer data including listing customers, filtering, and actions such as login, unlock, and navigation. It includes methods for displaying customer lists, handling filters, generating URLs, and integrating views and models.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer data in the admin panel, extending OpenCart's base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the customer list page, process filters, generate URLs, and load view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the API endpoint or action to return the list of customers, loading language, and calling getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Prepares filter data, retrieves customers from the model, and constructs the view data array.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the customer form for adding or editing a customer, setting up data such as customer info, stores, customer groups, custom fields, and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding/editing) customer data with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Performs customer unlock operations, such as resetting login attempts and generating login tokens.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected customer(s), checking user permissions and invoking the delete method for each customer ID.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in a customer by creating a token and redirecting to the store's login page with the token.

methods.name: payment
methods.description: Displays the payment methods associated with a customer, including subscription info and available payment options.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Retrieves payment methods, subscriptions, and related data for a customer; used internally by the payment method view.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history log for a specific customer, with pagination and data retrieval.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns a string of the customer's history log after processing filters and pagination.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history entry for a customer, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Displays a list of transactions related to a specific customer, paginated and formatted.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves and formats transaction data for a customer, including amount, description, and date, used in the view.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new transaction record for a customer after validation.

methods.name: reward
methods.description: Displays reward points and related data for a customer.

methods.name: getReward
methods.description: Fetches and formats reward points and data for a customer, including pagination.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points for a customer with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getReward
methods.description: Returns a string of reward points information for a customer, with pagination.

methods.name: reward
methods.description: Displays reward points data for a customer.

methods.name: getReward
methods.description: Fetches reward point details and formats pagination info.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a customer, or outputs the current IP if called in context.

methods.name: getIp
methods.description: Returns the IP address string of a customer, including filter parameters for pagination.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Handles authorization checks for a customer, returning the authorization info or error message.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves authorization tokens, status, and records related to a customer, with permission checks.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes an authorization record for a customer based on the provided authorize ID.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides a list of customer suggestions based on name or email filters, returning JSON data.

methods.name: customfield
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields applicable to a customer, including required status, and outputs JSON data.
